records.interpretation: Validation-selected versus final saved paths. Cost add-back is an accounting decomposition of those paths, not a cost-free backtest. Year returns carry the existing positions across year boundaries. Losses, entropy and saturation are diagnostics; they do not prove overfitting or establish a causal mechanism.
